samples.title: Der Mann am Fluss
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Der Mann ist alt. Sein Haus ist klein. Der Fluss ist kalt. Der Himmel ist blau. Im Keller ist eine Tasche. Der Mond ist groß. Auf dem Stuhl sitzt eine Katze. Im Tal ist ein Haus.
Der Zucker ist weiß. Auf dem Balkon steht ein Stuhl. Die Kartoffel ist groß. Die Schlange ist klein. Die Schokolade ist gut. Die Decke ist warm. Der Tiger ist stark. Es regnet.

samples.title: The Fisherman and the Fish
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: The old fisherman rowed his small boat across the calm water. He had left the harbour before dawn, when the sky was still dark and the air was cold. A gentle wind pushed the boat forward, and the far lights of the village slowly vanished behind him.

He cast his net near a line of rocks and waited. The sea was quiet, and the only sound was the slow breath of the waves against the wood. After a while, the net grew heavy. He lifted it in with careful hands, afraid that the rope might break.

Inside the net was a single silver fish, bright as a coin. The fisherman looked at it for a long moment. Then he opened his hands and let it fall back into the deep water. Some things are worth more than a full basket, he thought, and rowed home.

samples.title: El hombre y el mar
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: El hombre es viejo. Su barco es pequeño. El mar está tranquilo. El cielo está azul. En la colina hay un castillo. El jardín está cerca. El viento está frío. El pájaro es azul.
El océano está lejos. En la caja hay un libro y una maleta. Por la noche hay una tormenta. Después de la lluvia, el hombre está bien. Vuelve a casa.

samples.title: Le capitaine et la tempête
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Le capitaine est vieux. Son bateau est petit. La mer est calme. Le ciel est gris. Sur la colline, il y a un château. La forêt est proche. Le vent est froid. Le poisson est beau.
Dans la boîte, il y a un fromage et une bouteille. Le soir, il y a un orage. Après la tempête, le capitaine est content. Il rentre à la maison.

samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Il padre è vecchio. La sua barca è piccola. Il mare è bello. Il cielo è blu. Sulla montagna vedo un castello. Il giardino è vicino. In autunno il tempo è grigio. Il cane è bianco.
Il mare è grande. Nella scatola vedo un libro e un fiore. Di notte vedo un temporale. Al tramonto il cielo è bello. Dopo il temporale, il padre è felice. Torna a casa.

samples.title: O homem e o furacão
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: O homem é velho. O seu barco é pequeno. O mar está belo. O céu está azul. Na montanha vejo um templo. O jardim está perto. O vento está frio. O cão é branco.
